# Sauce Labs — Style Reference

> Field-journal ink on sun-warmed linen, with a keylime ribbon pinned across the top. A tightly tracked bookish serif and a typewriter mono are set in green-black #192319 on #f0f0ec linen, ruled by #c8c8be hairlines, under one lime bar.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Sauce Labs speaks a field-notebook editorial language. It is a test-automation platform dressed as a naturalist's journal rather than a control panel. The canvas is warm linen #f0f0ec. Sections step up to paper #f8f8f8 and feature cards lift to a near-white #fdfdfe. Text is a green-black ink #192319 rather than the conventional pure black. The chromatic budget is four hues, and none of them sits on an action. Keylime #abe082 owns the announcement bar, while sky #4790dd, sunbeam #f1be23 and ember #f55524 code the three outcome pillars as 8px dots and pixel-mosaic tints. Hierarchy comes from P22 Mackinac Pro at weight 400, tracked to −0.04em and stepping about 1.4× from 36px to 50px to 70px. The largest size, 92px, is reserved for numerals. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono at 12.5px uppercase supplies every label, link and button. The shape vocabulary splits into ink pills and 32px cards floated on 36px-blur shadows behind a 1px ink ring. The result reads as a research publication rather than a SaaS dashboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linen Canvas | `#f0f0ec` | `--color-linen-canvas` | Body background, the logo-marquee band and the gutters around pillar cards — the warm grey-green tint makes every white card read as paper laid on cloth. |
| Paper Surface | `#f8f8f8` | `--color-paper-surface` | Section bands, the video feature card and button text on ink (37 background uses, the most frequent fill) — a one-step lift that separates content zones without a border. |
| Frosted Card | `#fdfdfe` | `--color-frosted-card` | Pillar stat cards, the floating nav pill and the secondary button — the brightest surface in the system, kept for objects that physically float above the page. |
| Forest Ink | `#192319` | `--color-forest-ink` | All headlines and body copy (92 text uses), the primary pill button fill and the footer slab — green-black ink keeps the palette botanical. Do not swap it for pure black. |
| Moss Ink | `#3c483c` | `--color-moss-ink` | Pillar card descriptions, logo-row eyebrow and supporting paragraphs (20 uses) — a softened ink for second-level reading that stays inside the green family. |
| Ink Caption | `#192319a3` | `--color-ink-caption` | Hero eyebrow and mono section kickers (41 uses) — Forest Ink at 64% alpha, so captions recede on any surface without introducing a new grey. |
| Fog Text | `#dcdcd7` | `--color-fog-text` | Footer links, legal links and copy on the Forest Ink slab (71 uses) — a warm off-white that avoids the glare of #ffffff on dark green. |
| Stone Border | `#c8c8be` | `--color-stone-border` | Section hairlines, the vertical rule beside section headlines and the nav pill outline (29 border uses) — a khaki line that reads as pencil rather than chrome. |
| Ink Ring | `#0a140a1f` | `--color-ink-ring` | 1px outline on the pillar cards, video card and secondary button — a 12% green-black ring that crisps the shadow edge. Do not use it as a divider. |
| Keylime Signal | `#abe082` | `--color-keylime-signal` | The full-width announcement bar fill, the only saturated surface on the page — a flag above the masthead. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Sky Pulse | `#4790dd` | `--color-sky-pulse` | Quality pillar dot, bullet markers and the duotone video artwork — one of three coding hues. Do not use it on buttons or links. |
| Sunbeam Pulse | `#f1be23` | `--color-sunbeam-pulse` | Speed pillar dot, bullet markers and the yellow mosaic tint in the middle card — a coding hue that never carries text at small sizes on light grounds. |
| Ember Pulse | `#f55524` | `--color-ember-pulse` | Efficiency pillar dot, bullet markers and the orange mosaic corner — the warmest coding hue. Do not read it as an error state or use it for alerts. |

## Tokens — Typography

### P22 Mackinac Pro — the bookish display serif that carries every headline and statistic · `--font-p22-mackinac-pro`

- **Substitute:** Newsreader Display at 400, Source Serif 4 (opsz 60) at 400, Fraunces (opsz 72, SOFT 0, WONK 0) at 350. Mackinac draws slightly heavier than a high-contrast Didone at 400 but lighter than Libre Caslon, so match the moderate stroke and do not step up to 500.
- **Weights:** 400, 700
- **Sizes:** 22px, 24px, 36px, 50px, 70px, 92px
- **Line height:** 0.95 (50px, 70px, 92px), 1.1 (22px, 36px), 1.25 (24px at 700)
- **Letter spacing:** −0.88px at 22px, −1.44px at 36px, −2px at 50px, −2.8px at 70px, −6.44px at 92px
- **Role:** Weight 400 at 70px is the signature. Headlines are massive and quiet, and the authority comes from a book face set large rather than from stroke mass. The steps run 36 → 50 → 70 → 92, ratios of about 1.39, 1.4 and 1.31. That is steeper than a Major Third (1.25) and closer to an Augmented Fourth, so each level is a visible jump. Tracking holds at −0.04em through the headline range and tightens to −0.07em on 92px numerals, pulling the serif into a compact, engraved block. The single 700 instance is a system outlier and should not be reproduced.

### Atkinson Hyperlegible Next — the legibility-first workhorse for reading copy · `--font-atkinson-hyperlegible-next`

- **Substitute:** Atkinson Hyperlegible Next itself (free on Google Fonts) at the same weights, Public Sans at 400, Inter at 400 with +0.01em tracking. The 300 weight draws closer to a 350 at 14px, so do not substitute a hairline Light.
- **Weights:** 300, 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 13px, 14px, 15px, 16.5px, 18px, 24px, 32px
- **Line height:** 1.4 (14px, 15px, 16.5px, 18px), 1.1 (18px nav, 24px, 32px), 1.0 (13px)
- **Letter spacing:** −0.26px at 13px, 0px at 14px (weight 300), 0.28px at 14px (weight 500), 0.27px at 15px, 0.27px at 16.5px, 0.3px at 18px, −0.36px at 18px (nav), −0.48px at 24px, 0.16px at 32px
- **Role:** A typeface designed for low-vision readers signals accessibility as a brand value, an unusual choice where competitors default to Inter. Body copy carries positive tracking of about +0.017em, the opposite of the tight serif above it, so the two families pull apart in rhythm as well as form. Weight 300 is used only for footer links on dark ground, where light strokes offset the halation of #dcdcd7 on #192319.

### Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono — the lab-instrument voice for labels, nav and buttons · `--font-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono`

- **Substitute:** Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono itself (free on Google Fonts) at 500, IBM Plex Mono at 400, Geist Mono at 400. Plex and Geist draw heavier than Atkinson Mono, so their 400 matches this 500.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 11.5px, 12.5px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.6 (12.5px labels), 1.2 (12.5px stat captions), 1.0 (single-line kickers)
- **Letter spacing:** 0.23px at 11.5px, 0.25px at 12.5px, 0px at 14px
- **Role:** Every eyebrow, nav link, button label and stat caption is set in uppercase mono at 12.5px (71 uses). The tooling voice of a testing company sits inside the editorial frame. Tracking of +0.02em is light by small-caps convention, which usually runs +0.08em to +0.12em, because the monospace grid already supplies even spacing.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono | 500 | 12.5px | 1.6 | 0.25px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Atkinson Hyperlegible Next | 300 | 14px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Atkinson Hyperlegible Next | 400 | 15px | 1.4 | 0.27px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Atkinson Hyperlegible Next | 400 | 16.5px | 1.4 | 0.27px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Atkinson Hyperlegible Next | 400 | 18px | 1.4 | 0.3px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Atkinson Hyperlegible Next | 400 | 24px | 1.1 | -0.48px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | P22 Mackinac Pro | 400 | 36px | 1.1 | -1.44px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | P22 Mackinac Pro | 400 | 50px | 0.95 | -2px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | P22 Mackinac Pro | 400 | 70px | 0.95 | -2.8px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | P22 Mackinac Pro | 400 | 92px | 0.95 | -6.44px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in P22 Mackinac Pro at weight 400 with −0.04em tracking (−2.8px at 70px, −2px at 50px) — the regular-weight serif is the thesis, and its quietness is the authority.
- Use Forest Ink #192319 for headlines, body and the primary button fill — one green-black ink across text and action ties the page to the linen canvas.
- Set every label, nav link and button in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 500 at 12.5px uppercase with 0.25px tracking — the mono voice marks metadata and actions, separating them from reading copy.
- Ration saturated hue to 8px dots, mono labels and corner mosaics using #4790dd, #f1be23 and #f55524, with one hue per pillar — color codes categories, it does not decorate.
- Float content cards at a 32px radius on `0 8px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)` plus a 1px #0a140a1f ring — the diffuse shadow lifts the card while the ring keeps its edge printed.
- Give sections 100px of vertical rhythm and cards 60px of padding — at a 10px base unit, generous multiples keep the spacious, journal-like pace.
- Reserve the 92px display size for numerals with −6.44px tracking — proof figures earn the largest type and the 70px headline yields to them.

### Don't

- Don't bold the serif to 700 for emphasis — weight 400 at display sizes is the whole argument, and a heavy Mackinac turns a field journal into a tabloid.
- Don't fill the primary button with #4790dd or #abe082 — the CTA color is non-negotiable Forest Ink #192319, and a colored CTA would make the coding hues compete with the action.
- Don't set text in pure black #000000 (not a system token) — it drops the green undertone of #192319 and makes the #f0f0ec linen look dirty instead of warm.
- Don't replace the mono labels with sans small caps at weight 600 — losing Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono at 12.5px removes the lab-instrument voice that grounds the editorial serif.
- Don't round buttons to the 13px small-card radius — actions are always 9999px pills, and a squared button blurs the line between control and container.
- Don't compress section gaps to 40px on desktop — 100px is the default, and halving the air makes the page read as a dense dashboard.
- Don't introduce a fifth saturated hue for a new pillar or badge — the budget is four, and color should never appear without a category to code.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f0f0ec (Linen Canvas)
- elevated card: #fdfdfe (Frosted Card)
- primary text: #192319 (Forest Ink)
- secondary text: #3c483c (Moss Ink)
- hairline: #c8c8be (Stone Border)
- announcement accent: #abe082 (Keylime Signal)
- category coding: #4790dd (Sky Pulse), #f1be23 (Sunbeam Pulse), #f55524 (Ember Pulse)
- primary action: #192319 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars use the three pulse hues as solid fills only for categorical series. Area or background fills drop to a 20% tint, while all numerals, axes and labels stay in Forest Ink #192319 and Moss Ink #3c483c, so the data figure, not the hue, is the loudest element.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: an inline-flex pill with background #192319, text color #f8f8f8, no border, border-radius 9999px, height 48px and padding 0 20px. Set the label in "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono" weight 500 at 12.5px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.25px, line-height 1.0, with no shadow. On hover, keep the fill and raise the element with box-shadow 0px 8px 40px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1). Pair it 10px to the left of a secondary pill: background #fdfdfe, 1px solid #0a140a1f ring, radius 9999px, padding 4px 20px 4px 4px, with a 40px circular icon disc on the left and the same mono label in #192319.

2. Build a hero section on #f0f0ec with a vertical decorative gradient that starts at a soft yellow at 40% height and returns to #f0f0ec, with bottom corners rounded 0px 0px 40px 40px. Center everything in an 832px column with 120px top padding. Place a mono eyebrow in "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono" 500 at 12.5px uppercase, color #192319a3, letter-spacing 0.25px. Leave a 20px gap, then add an h1 in "P22 Mackinac Pro" weight 400 at 70px, line-height 0.95, letter-spacing −2.8px, color #192319. Leave a 30px gap, then a paragraph in "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next" 400 at 18px, line-height 1.4, letter-spacing 0.3px, color #192319. Leave a 30px gap, then the two pill buttons 10px apart, and finally a full-width illustration slot below with a 60px top margin.

3. Build a pillar stat card: 436px wide, background #fdfdfe, 1px solid #0a140a1f border, border-radius 32px, padding 60px, box-shadow 0px 8px 36px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.18). Inside, add an 8px circle in #4790dd followed 8px later by a mono label at 12.5px weight 500 uppercase. Leave a 10px gap, then an h3 in "P22 Mackinac Pro" 400 at 36px, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing −1.44px, #192319. Leave a 16px gap, then a 15px "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next" 400 description in #3c483c. After a 30px gap, add a numeral in Mackinac 400 at 92px with line-height 0.95 and letter-spacing −6.44px, followed by a 24px sans "%" suffix. Under it place a 12.5px mono uppercase caption, then a list whose bullets are 8px #4790dd dots with 15px text and 10px row gaps. Lay three cards in a row with 26px gaps.

4. Build a navigation bar: a centered capsule with max-width 1360px, height 60px, background #fdfdfe, 1px solid #c8c8be border, border-radius 9999px, padding 10px 10px 10px 20px, and no shadow, positioned static 26px below a full-width #abe082 announcement bar with 10px vertical padding. Put the wordmark on the left. Center six links set in "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono" 500 at 12.5px uppercase, letter-spacing 0.25px, color #192319, spaced 30px apart, each followed by a small chevron. On the right place a LOGIN text link and the #192319 pill button, 20px apart.

## Components

### Announcement Bar — Keylime
**Role:** Site-wide promotional flag above navigation

A full-bleed lime ribbon. It runs 1920px wide on #abe082 with Forest Ink #192319 text and no border or radius. Vertical padding is 10px. The message is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next at 14px weight 400, followed by a mono 12.5px uppercase link with 0.25px tracking. That link ends in a 20px Forest Ink circle holding a #abe082 arrow, and a mono "X" dismiss sits at the far right with 20px inset. It is the only saturated surface in the system, so it reads as a pinned notice rather than as brand chrome.

### Floating Nav Pill
**Role:** Primary site navigation, desktop

A detached capsule, not a bar. It sits on Frosted Card #fdfdfe with a 1px #c8c8be outline, 9999px radius, 1360px max-width, an estimated 60px height and 10px inner padding, with no shadow. The wordmark sits left in Forest Ink. Six links sit centered in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 500 at 12.5px uppercase, #192319, 0.25px tracking, 30px apart, each with a 10px chevron. LOGIN and the ink pill button sit right. The nav is static rather than sticky — it behaves like a masthead printed at the top of a page, not like an app toolbar.

### Pill Button — Ink (Primary)
**Role:** Book-a-demo and every primary conversion

The ink capsule. It is filled with Forest Ink #192319 and labeled in Paper Surface #f8f8f8, with no border, a 9999px radius, 0 20px padding and a 48px height. The label is Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 500 at 12.5px uppercase with 0.25px tracking, and there is no shadow. Most B2B sites fill the CTA with their brightest brand hue. This one inverts that convention, and the action is the darkest object on the page — conversion is signalled by contrast, not by color.

### Pill Button — Frosted With Icon Disc (Secondary)
**Role:** Start-free and secondary entry points

A paired companion capsule. It uses Frosted Card #fdfdfe, Forest Ink #192319 text, a 1px #0a140a1f ring, a 9999px radius, 4px 20px 4px 4px padding and a 48px height. A 40px circular disc sits on the left with the starburst mark in Paper Surface #f8f8f8 on an olive fill (#6d7344, decorative, not a system token). The label is Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 500 at 12.5px uppercase, and there is no shadow. It sits 10px from the primary button and reads as a softer, inviting option.

### Mono Eyebrow
**Role:** Section kicker above headlines

A whispered typewriter label. It has a transparent ground and Ink Caption #192319a3 text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 500 at 12.5px, uppercase, line-height 1.6, 0.25px tracking, with no border or radius. A 20px margin separates it from the serif headline below. The eyebrow is the system's metadata voice. It tags content the way a lab sample is labelled, and its 64% alpha keeps it subordinate to the 70px serif without adding another grey.

### Logo Marquee Row
**Role:** Enterprise social proof

A monochrome trust strip. It runs on Linen Canvas #f0f0ec under a Moss Ink #3c483c mono eyebrow at 12.5px uppercase. Seven customer logos sit at a 148px width each with 80px between them, rendered in Forest Ink #192319, with no cards, borders or shadows, and the row loops horizontally. Stripping customer brand colors keeps the four-hue budget intact — the logos are evidence, not decoration.

### Video Feature Card
**Role:** Product explainer video container

A framed film still. It measures 1186px wide by 667px tall on Paper Surface #f8f8f8 with a 1px #0a140a1f ring, a 24px radius and the md-2 shadow (0 7.34px 33px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)), with no padding. The artwork is a full-bleed Sky Pulse #4790dd duotone with a "What is AURA?" serif lockup in Paper Surface. A centered 80px play disc at 50% radius uses a translucent white fill. The 24px radius sits deliberately one step below the 32px pillar cards because this card frames an image, not text.

### Pillar Stat Card
**Role:** Three-outcome proof columns

The signature content card. It is 436px wide and 697px tall on Frosted Card #fdfdfe, with a 1px #0a140a1f ring, a 32px radius, 60px padding and the md shadow (0 8px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)). Inside, an 8px pulse dot and a mono 12.5px label sit above a 36px Mackinac headline. Below that come a 15px Moss Ink #3c483c description, a 92px numeral and bullets marked with pulse-colored 8px dots. A pixel-mosaic tint in the pillar's hue bleeds from one corner. Three cards sit 26px apart, and each is color-coded by exactly one hue.

### Stat Numeral Block
**Role:** Headline metric inside pillar cards

The largest type on the page is a number. It is set in P22 Mackinac Pro 400 at 92px with line-height 0.95 and −6.44px tracking in Forest Ink #192319. The unit suffix ("%", "% +") follows in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 400 at 24px, and below it sits a two-line Forest Ink mono caption at 12.5px uppercase with line-height 1.2 and 0.25px tracking, 10px beneath. Giving display size to data rather than to the hero headline is deliberate — proof outranks the promise.

### Editorial Section Header With Hairline
**Role:** Opens major content sections

A broadsheet column rule. It sits on a Paper Surface #f8f8f8 band with a 1px Stone Border #c8c8be vertical line running the full section height, offset left of the text column. The headline is P22 Mackinac Pro 400 at 70px with line-height 0.95 and −2.8px tracking, in #192319, constrained to 832px, with 16px padding-left from the rule. There is no radius or shadow. The hairline replaces the card and turns the section into a printed page with a margin rule.

### Platform Diagram Tag
**Role:** Labels nodes in architecture diagram

A tiny outlined chip. It sits on the dark Forest Ink #192319 diagram panel with transparent fill, a 1px Paper Surface #f8f8f8 border, a 4px radius and 4px 4px 2px padding. Its text is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 400 at 13px with line-height 1.0, −0.26px tracking and Paper Surface #f8f8f8 color. The 4px radius is the system outlier, the only near-sharp corner, and it is allowed because these chips imitate the boxes of a technical schematic rather than interactive UI.

### Footer Slab
**Role:** Sitemap, legal and consent links

An inverted ink ground. It spans 1920px of Forest Ink #192319 with 60px 60px 26px padding and no radius. Column headings are mono 12.5px uppercase in Fog Text #dcdcd7. Links are Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 300 at 14px with line-height 1.4 in #dcdcd7, stacked 10px apart. A 1px #ffffff4d divider (translucent, footer-only, not a system token) separates the legal row. Weight 300 on dark ground offsets light bleed, so the footer reads as quiet as the canvas above it.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in P22 Mackinac Pro at weight 400 with −0.04em tracking (−2.8px at 70px, −2px at 50px) — the regular-weight serif is the thesis, and its quietness is the authority.
- Use Forest Ink #192319 for headlines, body and the primary button fill — one green-black ink across text and action ties the page to the linen canvas.
- Set every label, nav link and button in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 500 at 12.5px uppercase with 0.25px tracking — the mono voice marks metadata and actions, separating them from reading copy.
- Ration saturated hue to 8px dots, mono labels and corner mosaics using #4790dd, #f1be23 and #f55524, with one hue per pillar — color codes categories, it does not decorate.
- Float content cards at a 32px radius on `0 8px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)` plus a 1px #0a140a1f ring — the diffuse shadow lifts the card while the ring keeps its edge printed.
- Give sections 100px of vertical rhythm and cards 60px of padding — at a 10px base unit, generous multiples keep the spacious, journal-like pace.
- Reserve the 92px display size for numerals with −6.44px tracking — proof figures earn the largest type and the 70px headline yields to them.

### Don't

- Don't bold the serif to 700 for emphasis — weight 400 at display sizes is the whole argument, and a heavy Mackinac turns a field journal into a tabloid.
- Don't fill the primary button with #4790dd or #abe082 — the CTA color is non-negotiable Forest Ink #192319, and a colored CTA would make the coding hues compete with the action.
- Don't set text in pure black #000000 (not a system token) — it drops the green undertone of #192319 and makes the #f0f0ec linen look dirty instead of warm.
- Don't replace the mono labels with sans small caps at weight 600 — losing Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono at 12.5px removes the lab-instrument voice that grounds the editorial serif.
- Don't round buttons to the 13px small-card radius — actions are always 9999px pills, and a squared button blurs the line between control and container.
- Don't compress section gaps to 40px on desktop — 100px is the default, and halving the air makes the page read as a dense dashboard.
- Don't introduce a fifth saturated hue for a new pillar or badge — the budget is four, and color should never appear without a category to code.

## Elevation

- **Pillar stat cards:** `0px 8px 36px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)` plus 1px `#0a140a1f` ring
- **Video feature card:** `0px 7.34px 33px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)` plus 1px `#0a140a1f` ring
- **Low-offset floating tiles (most frequent, 7 uses):** `0px 2px 44px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)`
- **Ambient panels and secondary floating tiles:** `0px 8px 40px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`
- **Layered lift for overlays and menus:** `0px 4px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0px 8px 40px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`

Every shadow uses a blur of 33px or more with 10–18% black. Conventional UI kits use tight 2–8px blurs, but these diffuse halos make cards look like paper cut-outs resting just above the linen. The 1px ink ring gives the soft shadow a crisp printed edge.

## Imagery

Imagery is illustration, not photography or product screenshots. The signature motif is a running cheetah rendered as dithered block pixels and halftone hatching in deep green with pink bloom clouds. It sits on a vertical yellow-to-linen gradient in the hero (yellow #f1e082 is decorative, not a system token), inside a section whose bottom corners round to 40px. The video card reuses the cheetah as a Sky Pulse #4790dd duotone with a square grid overlay, framed at a 24px radius with a 1px ring and shadow. Pillar cards repeat the pixel-mosaic as faint corner tints in their own hue. Icons are minimal line chevrons, an arrow-in-circle and a translucent play disc. Customer logos are flattened to Forest Ink. The gradient is decorative only and is not a system token. The narrative is speed made into data, a living animal pixelated into test output.

## Layout

Content centers on a 1360px max-width, with a narrower 1040px for card groups and an 832px headline column. Sections advance at a 100px default gap and alternate between Linen Canvas #f0f0ec and Paper Surface #f8f8f8 bands rather than using dividers. The hero is fully centered: mono eyebrow, a two-line 70px serif headline, an 18px paragraph, two pills 10px apart, then a full-width cheetah illustration. Features use a three-column grid of 436px cards with 26px gaps. Logos run as a single seven-across marquee, and pricing is not on the home page. The nav is a static floating pill, an estimated 60px tall, with the wordmark left, six mono links centered, and login plus the ink button right, all under the keylime bar. The footer is a full-bleed Forest Ink slab with multi-column link lists. At 375px, drop the hero headline to 36px (heading-sm), stack the cards in one column and use a 60px section gap. Density: spacious.

## Quiet Serif Authority

The discipline is weight restraint at scale. P22 Mackinac Pro stays at 400 from 22px to 92px, and the only lever for hierarchy is size, stepping about 1.4× per level with tracking pinned at −0.04em. The 70px h1 commands the hero because it is enormous and tight, not because it is heavy. It breaks the moment someone sets a headline to 600 for emphasis, adds a sans headline in Atkinson at 32px bold, or loosens tracking to 0 so the serif sprawls. Extend it by adding sizes on the same ratio, such as 128px for a campaign page at roughly −0.07em. Push emphasis into the 12.5px mono eyebrow or into Ink Caption #192319a3 contrast, not into stroke weight. A new section should always be able to state its headline quietly.

## Color As Coding

The discipline is that every saturated hue must mean something. Sky Pulse #4790dd is Quality, Sunbeam Pulse #f1be23 is Speed and Ember Pulse #f55524 is Efficiency. Each appears only as an 8px dot, bullet markers, a darker companion label tint and a mosaic corner on its own card. Keylime #abe082 is reserved for the announcement bar. It breaks when a hue lands on a button, when two hues mix inside one card, or when a pulse color becomes a section background. To extend it, add a fourth category only alongside a new pillar, keep the fill at dot size, and route every action through Forest Ink #192319.

## Decimal Spacing Rhythm

The discipline is a 10px base unit rather than the conventional 8px grid. The most frequent gaps are 20px (97 uses), 10px (83) and 30px (30), and they scale to 60px card padding and 100px section gaps. A deliberate 26px interval, used 67 times for card gutters and footer bottoms, sits between steps as an editorial half-measure. The 2px, 4px and 8px values exist only for optical nudges inside chips and dots. It breaks when a builder imports a 24px/48px/96px Tailwind rhythm, because the round decimal cadence starts to stutter. To extend it, choose multiples of 10px for structure and reuse 26px for gutters and 44px for interior offsets. Add a new spacing step only if it appears more than once.

## Similar Brands

- **Anthropic** — a warm off-white canvas and regular-weight serif headlines with near-black ink. Sauce Labs adds a mono label layer and pixel-art illustration where Anthropic uses hand-drawn marks.
- **Mailchimp** — illustration-led storytelling on a warm ground with a serif display voice. Mailchimp spends its yellow on surfaces, while Sauce Labs confines color to 8px coding dots.
- **Stripe Press** — a book-typography mindset applied to a tech brand, with large serif type, generous margins and hairline rules. Stripe Press is darker and more literary, while Sauce Labs stays light and data-driven.
- **BrowserStack** — the direct category competitor in cloud test automation. It is the instructive contrast because it fills CTAs with saturated brand color, where Sauce Labs inverts to an ink pill.
- **Granola** — a soft linen-toned canvas with an editorial serif and floating rounded cards. Granola's shadows are lighter, and Sauce Labs pushes blur to 36px or more at 18% black.
